editionLabel: Mayfair Games First Wealth English rules
firstPlayerRule: Choose at random who receives the starting-player marker. As an explicit alternative, let the smaller player begin.
clarifications: The marker holder acts first in each round. At round end, pass the marker to the opponent so the opening turn alternates between players.
